base_checkpoint_policy: one checkpoint per seed; no best-seed selection; report verified hash from reports.json

permissions.external_training_authorized: 2026-10-18 user explicitly selected independent external direction models; this config freezes bounded budget

metrics.NAR: count(frozen correct AND adapted wrong) / count(frozen correct); null when denominator=0
metrics.retention_caveat: official source valid is observed development, not an independent Day0 test; no shared denominator across independently trained datasets

scientific_claims.zero_shot: frozen model with no target reference or updates only
scientific_claims.tta: zero target labels, but target reference inputs observed; report separately from strict zero-shot
scientific_claims.mapping: no numeric label equality as semantic mapping
scientific_claims.causality: geographic condition labels do not identify packet loss, jitter or retransmission causes
scientific_claims.safety: NAR is measured; no prior guarantee of zero extra errors
scientific_claims.topology: joint embedding is descriptive, not proof of recovery or isometry

factor_gates.VersionDrift: mixed released drift files; require attributed per-row version manifest and semantic site mapping
factor_gates.NetworkDrift: require semantic site mapping and independent reference/query list; geography available, quantitative physical conditions unverified
factor_gates.BehaviorDrift: 20400 traces, 17739 exact URLs; require homepage/subpage semantic mapping and split audit

model.architecture: wide_bn Transformer; explicit code copied from pure-source run; random initialization per dataset/seed
model.selection: terminal epoch45; no target selection; no search
model.source_candidates: WTT deterministic hash120/class from historical only; AWF all2500/class from historical training archive; exclude effective-input conflicts/duplicates then choose hash100/class; no change to actual training rows per class
model.direction_input: sign; preserve order and zeros; truncate/pad5000; positional2x1800 direction counts; no invented timestamps

adaptation.gate_scope: BN affine and Transformer head LN only; final_norm/classifier locked; source BN buffers fixed

token_alignment.adain: reference-fitted channel moments eps1e-5; ratio clip[0.25,4]
token_alignment.objective: normalized source moment matching +1e-3 residual penalty; update projector only

exposure.wtt_future: old v3 saved only development12-12 scores; no future scores there. Current batch frozen benchmark; strict independent confirmation status not asserted without complete archive exposure audit
exposure.awf: heldout-reference diagnostic; no chronological date claim; source defined200-class mapping, unknown labels excluded and counted

splits.wtt: existing frozen future_query untouched except zero/conflict/duplicate/source-input exclusion; unlabeled reference from original future_reference_candidate, exclude query/source effective inputs, first1024 valid within hash2048 candidate budget
splits.awf: source from released training file; dedup future input; first1024 deterministic content-hash groups as unlabeled reference, remainder independent query; observed data not called new confirmation

repair_history.old_v2: 3-field (x,label,uid) unpack error; fixed in historical v3
repair_history.old_v3: server power outage; user confirmed2026-10-18, not code failure
repair_history.new: new two-field supervised and one-field unlabeled TensorDataset contracts; source-only class map; explicit label range validation; effective-input isolation; no old checkpoints
repair_history.preflight_v1: AWF class16 avito.ru first120 candidates had98 unique effective inputs, insufficient for100 source rows. Expand source-only inspection to full historical training pool; no target model inference or scoring occurred before revision. Actual100/class budget unchanged. Prior config/code/failure archived under artifacts/revisions/preflight_v1.

resume.source: reuse only completed terminal checkpoint matching config hash
resume.cells: reuse only exact dataset/seed/slice/condition plus prediction file hash; interrupted cell rerun from source

execution_parallelism: one worker per seed, sequential WTT/AWF within worker; immutable preflight feature caches and manifest shared read-only; score/progress files seed-specific; source checkpoints never shared across seeds
